status: provisional: candidates adopted for testing on 2026-11-10. Research will confirm, merge or remove them.
unit: A color pair: a ground color and a figure color, with an optional small accent. Ground and figure are assigned from visual evidence, never from the order a source lists colors.

neutralChromaCeiling.meaning: A color with OKLCH C at or below this value is neutral. It may be visibly tinted.

vibrant.meaning: A chromatic color is vibrant when it meets both floors. Relative chroma is C divided by the sRGB maximum C at the same L and h.

pastel.meaning: A chromatic color that is very light and gentle. Pastel colors count as muted for primary classification.

lightGround.meaning: The ground is Light when its OKLCH L is at least 0.60, otherwise Dark. Grounds inside the review band get lower confidence. For grays the WCAG black-or-white text crossover sits near L 0.58.

sameHueFamily.meaning: Two chromatic colors within this many degrees of OKLCH hue belong to one hue family.

multicolorAccentShare.meaning: An accent counts as playing a substantial role only when its declared share of area is at least this value.

flat.description: One label from eight, assigned by the first rule that matches.

classifications.label: Neutral
classifications.definition: Neutral colors define the pair. A chromatic accent may be present but does not define it.
classifications.test: Ground and figure are both neutral.

classifications.label: Colorful / Multicolor
classifications.definition: Several distinct chromatic colors play substantial roles.
classifications.test: Ground, figure and accent are all chromatic, their hues are pairwise more than one hue family apart, and the accent holds at least the multicolor accent share.

classifications.label: Two-Tone
classifications.definition: Both colors in the defining pair are chromatic and come from different hue families.
classifications.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and differ in hue by more than one hue family.

classifications.label: Monochromatic Foundation
classifications.definition: One hue family defines the pair, with variation mainly in lightness and chroma.
classifications.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and within one hue family.

classifications.label: Light + Vibrant
classifications.definition: A light ground with a vibrant chromatic color.
classifications.test: The ground is Light and the pair's chromatic color is vibrant.

classifications.label: Dark + Vibrant
classifications.definition: A dark ground with a vibrant chromatic color.
classifications.test: The ground is Dark and the pair's chromatic color is vibrant.

classifications.label: Light + Muted
classifications.definition: A light ground with a muted, pastel or otherwise subdued chromatic color.
classifications.test: The ground is Light and the pair's chromatic color is not vibrant.

classifications.label: Dark + Muted
classifications.definition: A dark ground with a muted or otherwise subdued chromatic color.
classifications.test: The ground is Dark and the pair's chromatic color is not vibrant.

flat.unresolved: Use Unresolved, with a proposed_label, when the evidence is image-led, gradient-led or otherwise does not fit. Recurring proposed labels are evidence for new categories.

twoAxis.description: A foundation value plus a structure value. Saturation stays in the secondary characteristics.

structure.label: Neutral
structure.test: Ground and figure are both neutral.

structure.label: Chromatic
structure.test: Exactly one of ground and figure is chromatic.

structure.label: Monochromatic
structure.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and within one hue family.

structure.label: Two-Tone
structure.test: Ground and figure are both chromatic and in different hue families.

structure.label: Multicolor
structure.test: As the flat Colorful / Multicolor test.
